notes.content:
# For more options and information see
# http://rptl.io/configtxt
# Some settings may impact device functionality. See link above for details

# Uncomment some or all of these to enable the optional hardware interfaces
#dtparam=i2c_arm=on
#dtparam=i2s=on
#dtparam=spi=on

# Enable audio (loads snd_bcm2835)
dtparam=audio=on

# Additional overlays and parameters are documented
# /boot/firmware/overlays/README

# Automatically load overlays for detected cameras
camera_auto_detect=1

# Automatically load overlays for detected DSI displays
display_auto_detect=1

# Automatically load initramfs files, if found
auto_initramfs=1

# Enable DRM VC4 V3D driver
dtoverlay=vc4-kms-v3d
max_framebuffers=2

# Don't have the firmware create an initial video= setting in cmdline.txt.
# Use the kernel's default instead.
disable_fw_kms_setup=1

# Run in 64-bit mode
arm_64bit=1

# Disable compensation for displays with overscan
disable_overscan=1

# Run as fast as firmware / board allows
arm_boost=1

[cm4]
# Enable host mode on the 2711 built-in XHCI USB controller.
# This line should be removed if the legacy DWC2 controller is required
# (e.g. for USB device mode) or if USB support is not required.
otg_mode=1

[cm5]
dtoverlay=dwc2,dr_mode=host

[all]

notes.title: test.txt
notes.content:
# For more options and information see
# http://rptl.io/configtxt
# Some settings may impact device functionality. See link above for details

# ===================== 硬件接口配置 =====================
# Uncomment some or all of these to enable the optional hardware interfaces
#dtparam=i2c_arm=on
#dtparam=i2s=on
#dtparam=spi=on

# Enable audio (loads snd_bcm2835)
dtparam=audio=on

# ===================== 自动检测配置 =====================
camera_auto_detect=1
display_auto_detect=1
auto_initramfs=1

# ===================== 图形显示配置（关键修改）=====================
# 使用FKMS驱动（保留开机动画），并添加兼容参数
dtoverlay=vc4-fkms-v3d
max_framebuffers=2
# 关闭KMS相关的自动设置（FKMS不需要）
disable_fw_kms_setup=0
# 强制帧缓冲区使用自定义分辨率（适配HDMI时序）
framebuffer_width=1920
framebuffer_height=384
framebuffer_depth=32
framebuffer_ignore_alpha=1

# ===================== 系统性能配置 =====================
arm_64bit=1
disable_overscan=1
arm_boost=1

# ===================== HDMI强制时序配置（优化）=====================
# 保留EDID基础信息，仅强制自定义时序（避免驱动冲突）
hdmi_ignore_edid=0x2000000
# HDMI组设置为DMT
hdmi_group=2
# 自定义模式
hdmi_mode=87
# 你的自定义时序
hdmi_timings=1920 0 52 34 2 384 0 20 7 2 0 0 0 60 0 49470000 3 0 0 0
# 强制HDMI热插拔
hdmi_force_hotplug=1
# HDMI模式（支持音频）
hdmi_drive=2
# 禁用显示自动检测（避免覆盖自定义时序）
display_auto_detect=0

# ===================== 特定型号配置 =====================
[cm4]
otg_mode=1

[cm5]
dtoverlay=dwc2,dr_mode=host

[all]
# 确保FKMS驱动优先加载
gpu_mem=256

notes.title: xp_build.sh.txt
notes.content:
#!/bin/bash

LOCALPATH=$(pwd)
OUT=${LOCALPATH}/out
CUSTOM_HOSTNAME="rpi4b"
echo -e "\e[36m build kernel start! + WiFi 支持 \e[0m"

export PATH=$PATH:/tool/gcc-arm-10.3-2021.07-x86_64-aarch64-none-linux-gnu/linux-x86/aarch64/gcc-arm-10.3-2021.07-x86_64-aarch64-none-linux-gnu/bin
export CROSS_COMPILE=aarch64-none-linux-gnu-

cd ${LOCALPATH}/linux

export ARCH=arm64
KERNEL=kernel8
DEFCONFIG=bcm2711_defconfig

echo "*********************** config is $DEFCONFIG ***********************"
echo "******************** start to make ($DEFCONFIG) *********************"

make ${DEFCONFIG}

# 强制开启 WiFi 驱动（brcmfmac 模块）
echo "强制启用 brcmfmac WiFi 驱动..."
if ! grep -q "CONFIG_BRCMFMAC=m" .config; then
    echo "CONFIG_BRCMFMAC=m" >> .config
    echo "CONFIG_BRCMUTIL=m" >> .config
    echo "CONFIG_CFG80211=m" >> .config
    echo "CONFIG_BRCMFMAC_SDIO=y" >> .config
    make olddefconfig
fi

echo "$(pwd)"
echo "********************** start to compile kernel **********************"
make -j16 Image modules dtbs

echo "$LOCALPATH"

cd ${LOCALPATH}/linux

sudo umount /media/wenlun/rootfs 2>/dev/null || true
sudo umount /media/wenlun/bootfs 2>/dev/null || true
sudo mount /dev/sdb1 ${LOCALPATH}/mnt/fat32
sudo mount /dev/sdb2 ${LOCALPATH}/mnt/ext4

sudo make -j16 INSTALL_MOD_PATH=${LOCALPATH}/mnt/ext4 modules_install

# ====== WiFi 支持开始（增加下载进度显示） ======
echo -e "\e[33m 配置 WiFi（自动下载固件 + 设置） \e[0m"

sudo mkdir -p ${LOCALPATH}/mnt/ext4/lib/firmware/brcm

TMP_DIR=$(mktemp -d)
cd "$TMP_DIR"

echo "开始下载 RPi4 WiFi 固件文件（显示进度条）..."

# 1. 主固件 bin
echo -e "\e[32m正在下载 brcmfmac43455-sdio.bin ...\e[0m"
wget --show-progress --progress=bar:force https://git.kernel.org/pub/scm/linux/kernel/git/firmware/linux-firmware.git/plain/brcm/brcmfmac43455-sdio.bin -O brcmfmac43455-sdio.bin
if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then
    echo -e "\e[32m[成功] brcmfmac43455-sdio.bin 下载完成\e[0m"
else
    echo -e "\e[31m[失败] brcmfmac43455-sdio.bin 下载失败，请检查网络或手动下载\e[0m"
fi

# 2. clm_blob（监管域/信道信息）
echo -e "\e[32m正在下载 brcmfmac43455-sdio.clm_blob ...\e[0m"
wget --show-progress --progress=bar:force https://git.kernel.org/pub/scm/linux/kernel/git/firmware/linux-firmware.git/plain/brcm/brcmfmac43455-sdio.clm_blob -O brcmfmac43455-sdio.clm_blob || \
wget --show-progress --progress=bar:force https://git.kernel.org/pub/scm/linux/kernel/git/firmware/linux-firmware.git/plain/cypress/cyfmac43455-sdio.clm_blob -O brcmfmac43455-sdio.clm_blob
if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then
    echo -e "\e[32m[成功] brcmfmac43455-sdio.clm_blob 下载完成\e[0m"
else
    echo -e "\e[31m[失败] clm_blob 下载失败，请检查网络或手动下载\e[0m"
fi

# 3. RPi4 专用 NVRAM（重命名为标准 txt）
echo -e "\e[32m正在下载 brcmfmac43455-sdio.raspberrypi,4-model-b.txt ...\e[0m"
wget --show-progress --progress=bar:force https://git.kernel.org/pub/scm/linux/kernel/git/firmware/linux-firmware.git/plain/brcm/brcmfmac43455-sdio.raspberrypi,4-model-b.txt -O brcmfmac43455-sdio.txt
if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then
    echo -e "\e[32m[成功] NVRAM 文件下载完成（已重命名为 brcmfmac43455-sdio.txt）\e[0m"
else
    echo -e "\e[31m[失败] NVRAM 下载失败，请检查网络或手动下载\e[0m"
fi

# 复制到 rootfs
sudo cp -f brcmfmac43455-sdio.bin      ${LOCALPATH}/mnt/ext4/lib/firmware/brcm/ 2>/dev/null && echo "已复制 bin 文件"
sudo cp -f brcmfmac43455-sdio.clm_blob ${LOCALPATH}/mnt/ext4/lib/firmware/brcm/ 2>/dev/null && echo "已复制 clm_blob 文件"
sudo cp -f brcmfmac43455-sdio.txt      ${LOCALPATH}/mnt/ext4/lib/firmware/brcm/ 2>/dev/null && echo "已复制 NVRAM 文件"

cd ${LOCALPATH}/linux
rm -rf "$TMP_DIR"

# 自动加载模块 + 参数优化
sudo bash -c "echo 'brcmfmac' > ${LOCALPATH}/mnt/ext4/etc/modules-load.d/brcmfmac.conf"

sudo bash -c "cat > ${LOCALPATH}/mnt/ext4/etc/modprobe.d/brcmfmac.conf" << EOF
options brcmfmac roamoff=1 feature_disable=0x82000 p2pon=0
EOF

# 地区码 SG
sudo bash -c "echo 'REGDOMAIN=SG' > ${LOCALPATH}/mnt/ext4/etc/default/crda"

# WiFi 凭证配置（Ubuntu 路径）
sudo mkdir -p ${LOCALPATH}/mnt/ext4/etc/wpa_supplicant

cat << EOF | sudo tee ${LOCALPATH}/mnt/ext4/etc/wpa_supplicant/wpa_supplicant.conf
ctrl_interface=DIR=/var/run/wpa_supplicant GROUP=netdev
update_config=1
country=SG

network={
    ssid="bhdisplay"          # 修改这里
    psk="bhdisplay1234"       # 修改这里
    key_mgmt=WPA-PSK
    priority=1
}
EOF

sudo chmod 600 ${LOCALPATH}/mnt/ext4/etc/wpa_supplicant/wpa_supplicant.conf

sudo chroot ${LOCALPATH}/mnt/ext4 systemctl enable wpa_supplicant.service 2>/dev/null || true

echo -e "\e[32m WiFi 配置完成，开机后 wlan0 应出现并尝试连接 \e[0m"
# ====== WiFi 支持结束 ======

sudo rm -rf ${LOCALPATH}/mnt/fat32/overlays
sudo mkdir ${LOCALPATH}/mnt/fat32/overlays

sudo cp arch/arm64/boot/Image ${LOCALPATH}/mnt/fat32/$KERNEL.img
sudo cp arch/arm64/boot/dts/broadcom/*.dtb ${LOCALPATH}/mnt/fat32/
sudo cp arch/arm64/boot/dts/overlays/*.dtb* ${LOCALPATH}/mnt/fat32/overlays/
sudo cp arch/arm64/boot/dts/overlays/README ${LOCALPATH}/mnt/fat32/overlays/

sudo cp ${LOCALPATH}/ubuntu-rootfs/* ${LOCALPATH}/mnt/ext4 -rfpd

if ! grep -q "/boot/firmware" ${LOCALPATH}/mnt/ext4/etc/fstab; then
    echo "PARTUUID=efab4ffe-01 /boot/firmware vfat defaults 0 2" | sudo tee -a ${LOCALPATH}/mnt/ext4/etc/fstab
fi

echo -e "\e[33m 开始修改主机名为：${CUSTOM_HOSTNAME} \e[0m"
sudo bash -c "echo ${CUSTOM_HOSTNAME} > ${LOCALPATH}/mnt/ext4/etc/hostname"
sudo sed -i "s/127.0.1.1.*$/127.0.1.1 ${CUSTOM_HOSTNAME}/g" ${LOCALPATH}/mnt/ext4/etc/hosts
sudo sed -i "/::1/a ::1 ${CUSTOM_HOSTNAME}" ${LOCALPATH}/mnt/ext4/etc/hosts

sudo cp ${LOCALPATH}/boot/* ${LOCALPATH}/mnt/fat32/

sudo cp ${LOCALPATH}/linux/arch/arm64/boot/dts/broadcom/bcm2711-rpi-4-b.dtb ${LOCALPATH}/mnt/fat32/

sleep 3
sudo umount ${LOCALPATH}/mnt/fat32
sudo umount ${LOCALPATH}/mnt/ext4

echo -e "\e[36m build end! 系统 + WiFi 已完成 \e[0m"
echo "调试提示：开机后运行 dmesg | grep -i brcm 查看驱动/固件加载情况"

notes.title: xp07.sh.txt
notes.content:
#!/bin/bash
# 树莓派4B 64位系统 视频循环播放脚本
# 适配预装的omxplayer硬件加速

# ===================== 配置项（根据实际修改）=====================
VIDEO_PATH="loop.mp4"  # 视频文件路径
AUDIO_OUTPUT="hdmi"  # 音频输出：hdmi（HDMI口）/ local（3.5mm耳机口）
DELAY=5  # 开机延迟执行（秒），确保系统完全加载
# ===============================================================

# 1. 等待系统加载完成（避免过早执行导致播放失败）
sleep ${DELAY}

# 2. 检查视频文件是否存在
if [ ! -f "${VIDEO_PATH}" ]; then
    echo "错误：视频文件不存在！路径：${VIDEO_PATH}" >> video_loop_error.log
    exit 1
fi

# 3. 配置音频输出（可选：解决无声音问题）
amixer cset numid=3 $( [ "${AUDIO_OUTPUT}" = "hdmi" ] && echo 2 || echo 1 )

# 4. 无限循环播放视频（硬件加速+全屏+无控制条）
echo "开始循环播放视频：${VIDEO_PATH}"
while true; do
    # omxplayer 参数说明：
    # --loop 循环播放  --no-osd 隐藏控制条  -b 黑屏背景  -o 指定音频输出
    omxplayer --loop --no-osd -b -o ${AUDIO_OUTPUT} "${VIDEO_PATH}"
    # 播放中断后短暂延迟，避免CPU占用过高
    sleep 1
done

notes.title: XP07_Hdmi.txt
notes.content:
[all]
# ===================== 核心I2C0配置（解决8bit读取关键）=====================
# 1. 启用I2C0并释放复用（保留你的原有配置，补充关键参数）
dtparam=i2c0=on                    # 启用I2C0总线
dtparam=i2c0_baudrate=400000       # 关键：I2C0设为400KHz快速模式（匹配传感器时序）
dtoverlay=i2c0,nocombine           # 关键：禁用7bit地址解析，强制8bit数据传输
dtoverlay=i2c0,pullup=on           # 关键：启用I2C0引脚内部上拉（增强驱动能力）
dtparam=i2c_arm=on                 # 兼容I2C1（若不用可注释）
dtparam=eeprom=off                 # 关闭eeprom避免占用I2C0

# 2. 释放I2C0引脚复用（保留你的配置，确认生效）
dtoverlay=disable-csi              # 释放CSI占用的I2C0引脚
dtoverlay=disable-dsi              # 释放DSI占用的I2C0引脚
dtoverlay=disable-bt               # 禁用蓝牙，释放UART/I2C0复用
enable_uart=1                      # 仅保留UART功能（不冲突）

# ===================== 显示驱动（保留，无冲突）=====================
dtoverlay=vc4-fkms-v3d
max_framebuffers=2
# enable_fw_kms_setup=1  # 保持注释：避免抢占GPIO

# ===================== GPIO配置（增强稳定性）=====================
dtparam=gpio=on
gpio=0=pu,1=pu                     # 关键：给I2C0的SDA0(BCM0)/SCL0(BCM1)强制上拉
# gpio=12=pu  # 触摸屏中断脚（根据实际硬件调整）

# ===================== 基础系统配置（保留）=====================
arm_64bit=1
disable_overscan=1
arm_boost=1
kernel=kernel8.img
core_freq=250

# ===================== 屏幕时序（保留）=====================
hdmi_ignore_edid=0xa5000080
hdmi_group=2
hdmi_mode=87
hdmi_timings=1920 0 52 34 2 384 0 20 7 2 0 0 0 60 0 49470000 3 0 0 0
hdmi_force_hotplug=1
hdmi_drive=2

[cm4]
otg_mode=1
